title: PDV Phase 20 Argonian Hist, People, and Void implementation costing
designRules: Hist and People play must be viable before Void/Sithis receives deeper runtime reward.
Sithis is a threshold layer, not the default Argonian build.

Sithis/Void activation requires three significant signals. Dark Brotherhood initiation or end-state milestones count as significant signals but never bypass the threshold alone. Future death/void/change quests are expected but remain candidate-only until exact quest/stage/outcome readback is approved.

People-layer launch promotion is exact-source only: Argonian Ceremony text, Histcarp/shared-food continuity, and Derkeethus rescue completion. Windhelm Assemblage and Jaree-Ra remain candidate/extrapolation targets until exact quest/stage/outcome readback is approved.
Water, rest, reflection, and chosen-family cadence should feel like maintenance, not chores.
Vampire, werewolf, and domination pressure change Hist posture visibly without deleting Saxhleel identity.
Community support must have readable surfacing because vanilla social hooks are sparse.

notes: Tracks Hist, People, and Void relation keys quietly behind the layered Argonian standing.
Dawn decay should be gentle and capped so normal play trends maintainable.
Normal can still mean distant-in-Skyrim; it is the healthy exile state.
Silenced is vampire grief; Corrupted requires stronger domination pressure.
The current proof slice stores bed-of-choice cadence in PDV_Substrate_ArgonianHist counters rather than a separate CK state-track record.
Promote to a dedicated placed-anchor or sacred-place record only when player-designated bed support lands.
One active chosen-bed anchor at a time.
Repeating one generic inn bed must not become the People economy.

favorFamilies.rewardIntent: Hist distance shrinks through place, not through grind

favorFamilies.sourcePromotionRule: Launch source-fill is limited to exact approved sources: Argonian Ceremony text, Histcarp/shared-food continuity, and Derkeethus rescue completion. Future named-aid quests are candidates only until exact quest/stage/outcome readback and rejected-context rules are approved.

favorFamilies.rewardIntent: make sparse vanilla Argonian community visible
favorFamilies.sourcePromotionRule: Windhelm Assemblage is a heavy People-lane target, but generic Windhelm presence, Riften presence, and ordinary Argonian NPC contact are rejected. Promote only exact Assemblage quest/favor outcomes after readback.

Future death/void/change quest beats should be added, but only from the candidate queue after exact quest/stage/outcome readback, accepted context, rejected context, duplicate guard, and evidence are approved. Each promoted source contributes one significant signal toward the three-signal gate.

favorFamilies.rewardIntent: Sithis route payoff after activation, not before
favorFamilies.sourcePromotionRule: Dark Brotherhood initiation/end-state milestones are one-shot significant signals; contracts or later Brotherhood content need exact/control-gated routing and must not become radiant assassination loops.

rejectedHooks: one Dark Brotherhood join event as full Sithis activation
curse state silently replacing Hist identity

triggerSurfaces.name: PDV ARGONIAN HIST MAINTENANCE SIGNAL
triggerSurfaces.immersionProof: A safe water/reflection proxy for maintaining a distant Hist connection; not a generic swimming faucet.

triggerSurfaces.name: PDV ARGONIAN PEOPLE SUPPORT SIGNAL
triggerSurfaces.immersionProof: A chosen-community proxy for Saxhleel mutual aid in Skyrim's sparse Argonian social world.

triggerSurfaces.name: PDV ARGONIAN VOID SIGNAL
triggerSurfaces.immersionProof: A threshold Sithis signal used only to prove repeated significant death-facing events; one signal is not full activation.

triggerSurfaces.name: PDV ARGONIAN BED OF CHOICE SIGNAL
triggerSurfaces.immersionProof: A chosen-bed cadence proof for the family the exile chose; repeating any generic inn bed must not count.

immersionProof.signaturePromise: Hist memory, chosen people, and Void distance define Argonian exile identity before Sithis ever becomes attractive.
diegeticTriggerMeaning: Water, reflection, Hist sap, and chosen-bed cadence are maintenance of distant Hist connection rather than survival stat faucets.
People-layer rewards make chosen community visible; Void rewards require threshold death-facing signals, not ordinary stealth.
feedbackSurface: Hist posture messages and Survey layered copy explain Normal, Distant, Strained, Silenced, and Corrupted states.
Bed-of-choice, Hist sap, and community notifications teach maintenance, lapse, and belonging without requiring constant popups.
rejectedGenericBehavior: one Dark Brotherhood join event as full Sithis activation
immersionProof.normalSessionFeel: A non-assassin Argonian can feel spiritually maintained through water, rest, reflection, and community support without needing Dark Brotherhood play.
immersionProof.runtimePromotionGate: Before Void expansion, prove one Hist/People maintenance loop, one chosen-community surface, and negative cases for water, bed, and murder farming.

rules: state surfaces, enum values, and required content rows are present before runtime work
Hist and People hooks are costed before deeper Void expansion
rejected hook families are converted into verifier or runtime negative cases before build completion
runtime proof includes non-assassin Argonian maintenance and Sithis threshold tests

positive: a non-assassin Argonian can maintain identity through water, rest, reflection, and community aid

People-layer launch sources route only from exact approved Argonian Ceremony, Histcarp, and Derkeethus sources, while Windhelm Assemblage, Jaree-Ra, and future quests remain candidate-only until readback
a chosen bed can be designated, returned to, and lapsed with readable feedback
three significant Void signals can activate Sithis without making the first Dark Brotherhood beat sufficient, and future death/void/change quests contribute only after exact readback approval
vampire and werewolf states produce distinct Hist posture and recovery behavior
negative: standing in water or swimming repeatedly does not farm Hist gain
generic inn sleep does not satisfy bed-of-choice cadence
ordinary stealth, ordinary kills, or a single Brotherhood join do not activate Sithis
vampire state does not delete Argonian identity or become a cleaner route

firstImplementationSlice: Create or wire the Hist substrate and Hist posture enum/readback before Void reward expansion.
Add Hist sap, water/reflection maintenance, and bed-of-choice cadence with anti-farm gates.
Wire community recognition for Windhelm/Riften or named Argonian aid as visible People support.
Add negative tests for water loops, generic sleep, generic murder, and first-join Sithis shortcuts.
